title: Sparky's Rooftop Groove
logline: A shy robot overcomes its inhibitions to find joy and connection through dance at a lively rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming shyness, self-expression, finding joy in unexpected places

characters.name: Sparky
characters.one_line_description: A small, somewhat boxy robot with expressive LED eyes, initially shy and hesitant.

characters.name: Maya
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant and friendly human dancer, full of encouragement and positive energy.

characters.name: DJ Beat
characters.one_line_description: The cool, unseen DJ providing the upbeat music for the party.

scenes.title: Arrival at the Party
scenes.summary: Sparky arrives at a vibrant rooftop party, hesitating at the edge of the dance floor, intimidated by the energetic crowd.
scenes.setting: A bustling rooftop party at sunset, city lights in the background, upbeat music playing.

scenes.title: Observing the Groove
scenes.summary: Sparky watches various people dancing, mimicking some moves with its head, but too shy to join in, feeling out of place.
scenes.setting: The edge of the dance floor, surrounded by happy dancers.

scenes.title: A Friendly Invitation
scenes.summary: Maya notices Sparky, smiles warmly, and gestures for it to join the dance, offering a reassuring hand.
scenes.setting: Amidst the lively party crowd, near Sparky's observation spot.

scenes.title: First Awkward Steps
scenes.summary: Sparky tentatively attempts a few stiff, robotic dance moves, feeling self-conscious but determined, with Maya cheering it on.
scenes.setting: The dance floor, a small space cleared by Maya.

scenes.title: Finding the Rhythm
scenes.summary: Suddenly, Sparky finds its unique groove, transforming its robotic movements into a surprisingly fluid and joyful dance, joined by Maya and other partygoers.
scenes.setting: The center of the dance floor, everyone celebrating.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
